manifestations.description: residual pain in his right wrist
residual pain in his left middle finger
tenderness and/or redness over the occipital area and face
tenderness and/or redness over the right knee
tenderness and/or redness over the right hand
mild swelling and tenderness over the radial side of his right wrist with decreased range of movement
tenderness and swelling at the proximal interphalangeal joint of his left middle finger with limited active range of movement
intermittent pain worse with activities (eg prolonged driving and controlling the steering wheel)
X-ray and CT scan did not reveal any fracture
whole person impairment estimated to be 2.5%

treatments_received.treatment: A&E treatment; X-ray and CT scan
source: He was taken to the A&E Department of Tuen Mun Hospital. He complained of head injury, right hand and right knee injury. On examination, the doctor found that there was tenderness and/or redness over the occipital area, face, right knee and right hand. X-ray and CT scan did not reveal any fracture. He was treated and discharged.
He was treated conservatively with medication.
He also attended a number of physiotherapy sessions.
Due to persistent pain in his right wrist and left middle finger, he attended out-patient clinics for treatment over the following two months or so.

losses.description: Reduced ability to work as a taxi driver post-accident: initially could only work about one to two days a week, later three to four days a week; in oral testimony said could only work one day followed by two days' rest ("做一日，休一日").
